deviations.claim_in_article: “Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.” The headline and closing summary also refer broadly to “oil prices.”
deviations.issue: The Ledger verifies the short-term movement of Brent crude futures: they briefly lost gains and then returned near their earlier high level. The article generalizes this observation to oil prices across the market, which goes beyond the verified scope.
deviations.explanation: The claim broadens a Brent-specific observation to oil prices generally, so changed_scope is true. This broader wording is also present in the Japanese source.
